guidance: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University lists a soil pH range of 6.5 to 7.5 for tomato cultivation in its general tomato soil guidance. Check the local soil-test result before deciding whether any pH correction is needed.
source: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University - Tomato Soil Requirements

guidance: Tomatoes need careful irrigation with sufficient water at appropriate times. TNAU notes that maintaining an even water supply is important. Check actual soil moisture and drainage before changing irrigation; the appropriate schedule depends on growing conditions.
source: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University - Organic Tomato Water Management

guidance: TNAU describes nitrogen deficiency in tomato as restricted shoot growth and spindly plants, with older leaves initially turning yellowish-green. Yellow leaves alone do not confirm nitrogen deficiency. Check other symptoms and obtain a soil or plant nutrient assessment before deciding on treatment.
source: Tamil Nadu Agricultural University - Nitrogen Deficiency in Tomato
